assertions.text: Response states the git show lines in Preflight step 5 use '|| true' so a first-run failure doesn't abort the chained Bash invocation
Response explains that without this, step 6 and the closing echo would never run, losing all resolved state ($RUN, $BASE, etc.)
Response states the Read/Write fallback runs as separate tool calls after the chain, using the echoed $RUN value and the echoed presence signal
